name: Aegir's Breath
descriptionHtml:
You blow a cloud of frigid air at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Cold damage, or 1d12 if the target is at least partially submerged in water.


Cantrip Upgrade.

The spell creates two clouds at level 5, three clouds at level 11, and four clouds at level 17. You can direct the clouds at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each cloud.
higherLevelHtml:
Cantrip Upgrade.

The spell creates two clouds at level 5, three clouds at level 11, and four clouds at level 17. You can direct the clouds at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each cloud.

name: Angrboda's Fury
descriptionHtml:
When you cast this spell, you open yourself up to become a conduit of the rage of the giant goddess Angrboda. One creature within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes Vulnerability to one type of damage of your choice. If the creature has Immunity to the damage type you selected, it loses its Immunity and takes damage as normal, but it does not have Vulnerability to the damage type you chose.

The creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this spell on a success.

name: Aspect of the Narwhal
descriptionHtml: A willing creature that you touch takes on the aspects of a narwhal. It grows flippers and a long horn-like tusk. The target gains Resistance to Cold damage while submerged in water, its Speed becomes 5 feet, and it gains a Swim Speed of 50 feet. The target can take a Bonus Action on any turn in which it moves at least 15 feet directly toward an enemy to make a gore attack that deals Piercing damage equal to 2d6 plus its Strength modifier.

name: Awaken Ship Guardian
descriptionHtml:
You summon a protective spirit to live within the hull of a Large or larger ship. While the spell lasts, the ship has the following benefits:

  • Immunity to Fire damage.
  • Each time the ship takes damage from a Large or larger creature, the attacking creature makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking 5d6 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
  • As a Bonus Action while you are on the ship, you can expend a spell slot, and the ship regains Hit Points equal to three times the slot level plus your spellcasting modifier.

name: Bearstormer
components: V, S, M (a pinch of bear fur)
descriptionHtml:
You create three phantasmal grizzly bears in a 20-foot Cube [Area of Effect] within range. Until the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to move the Cube [Area of Effect] up to 40 feet.

When the Cube [Area of Effect] appears, each enemy in it makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space and when a creature enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You increase the size of the Cube [Area of Effect] by 20-feet, the number of phantasmal bears by two, and the damage by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 5th.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You increase the size of the Cube [Area of Effect] by 20-feet, the number of phantasmal bears by two, and the damage by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 5th.

name: Beast of Ragnarok
components: V, S, M (a bezoar formed in a wolf's stomach)
descriptionHtml:
The spectral aura of Fenris surrounds you as you draw Ragnarok to the world for a moment. Until the spell ends, the sky grows dark, casting the world in Dim Light in a 1-mile Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on you. Thick snows fall inside the Sphere [Area of Effect], causing the ground to become Difficult Terrain and vision to be Heavily Obscured.

You gain the following benefits for the Duration:

  • You see clearly within the Sphere [Area of Effect] and are unaffected by the Difficult Terrain caused by the spell.
  • You have Advantage on all D20 Test.
  • All creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
  • You have Immunity to all types of damage except for one. Roll a d12 to randomly determine a damage type (1. Acid, 2. Bludgeoning, 3. Fire, 4. Force, 5. Lightning, 6. Necrotic, 7. Piercing, 8. Poison, 9. Psychic, 10. Radiant, 11. Slashing, or 12. Thunder.) You have Vulnerability to the damage type you roll.
  • You have Advantage on saving throws to resist or end all conditions.

name: Bergelmir's Provocation
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when you see a creature make an attack or spell attack)
descriptionHtml: The creature making the attack must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature makes the attack against a different eligible target of your choice, which cannot include the creature itself. If there is no other eligible target, the creature's attack is wasted.

name: Beseech the Norns
components: V, S, M (a silver spindle worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
descriptionHtml:
You contact one of the three The Norns, the weavers of fate, to intercede on your behalf by altering the past, present, or future. Choose one of the following effects:

  • Change the Past (Uror).

    Choose a creature you can see that died since the start of your last turn. That creature is returned to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive any creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.

  • Guide the Present (Verthandi).

    Treat the first attack roll or ability check you roll before the end of your turn as a natural 20.

  • Shape the Future (Skuld).

    Beginning at the start of your next turn and lasting for 1 minute, you have Advantage on all ability checks and saving throws.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that the spell has no effect (other than to consume the material component).

name: Billowing Sails
descriptionHtml: You touch a ship or other wind-powered vehicle and fill its sails with a strong breeze. Whenever the ship travels by sail, its Speed increases by 10 ft. or by 1 mph.

name: Bone-Chilling Smite
castingTime: 1 bonus action (which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike)
descriptionHtml:
The target takes an extra 3d8 Necrotic damage from the attack, and it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Exhaustion until the spell ends.

At the end of each of its turns, the Exhaustion target repeats the save. On a success, it removes all Exhaustion caused by this spell. On a failure, it receives one level of Exhaustion.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3rd.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Bound Fortunes
components: V, S, M (two small spindles bound together with thread)
descriptionHtml: You touch another willing creature and bind your fates together until the spell ends. For the duration, if the target is within 60 feet of you and makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you may use your Reaction to allow the target to reroll and use the new result. The target can do the same to you. Each time you do this, your, and only your Hit Point maximum is reduced by 1d4, and the same is true of the target. If this reduces your Hit Point maximum to 0, you die. This reduction is removed when the spell ends.

name: Bragi's Theatrical Fall
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when an attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright)
components: V, M (a drop of your blood)
descriptionHtml:
With a gasp and loud proclamation, you seem to fall dead to the ground. Instead of being reduced to 0 Hit Points, you are reduced to a number of Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. At the same time, you have the Invisible condition, and an illusion of your dead body appears, lying in the space where your body would have fallen.

If a creature takes the Study action to examine your illusory body, the creature can determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

The Invisible condition ends if you take the Attack action, use the Magic action to cast a spell that lets a creature regain Hit Points, or use any action to cause harm to a creature.

name: Branch and Root of Yggdrasil
components: V, S, M (branch, leaf, or bark from a World Tree)
descriptionHtml:
All trees are intrinsically linked to Yggdrasil. When you cast this spell and touch a tree, you and up to eight willing creatures in contact with that tree are transported to a random location on Yggdrasil. If you are touching a World Tree found on the mortal plane (such as those found in the Northlands) when you cast the spell, you can specify a target destination on Yggdrasil in general terms, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the GM.

Using this magic requires a sacrifice from the caster. After casting this spell, your Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of one of your Hit Point Dice until you complete a Long Rest.

name: Call to Action
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take in response to another creature's turn starting)
descriptionHtml: The creature starting its turn may immediately use its Reaction to take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action.

name: Claws of the Bear
components: V, S, M (a tuft of bear fur)
descriptionHtml:
You imbue yourself with the claws of a bear. You transform your arms into a pair of muscular, furred paws and make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to 3d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier and, if the target is no more than one size category larger than you, it has the Prone condition. For the duration of the spell, you can make attacks with the claws.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

When you cast this spell using a 5th- or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 4d10. When you cast it using a 7th- or 8th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 5d10. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases to 6d8.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

When you cast this spell using a 5th- or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 4d10. When you cast it using a 7th- or 8th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 5d10. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases to 6d8.

name: Coldheart
descriptionHtml:
You cause a supernatural chill to fall upon one Beast or Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it receives 1 Exhaustion level.

At the end of its next turn, the target must make another Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature receives 1 Exhaustion level. Then the spell ends. Exhaustion applied by this spell is not removed by the end of the spell.

name: Compel Avarice
descriptionHtml: This spell twists the target creature's perceptions, inflaming its greed. You choose an object you can see when you cast this spell. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to try to take that item for itself for the duration of the spell. It will try to steal the item if possible, and if it is unable to, it will fight the item's current holder. If the target is able to claim the object, it will flee from all other creatures to jealously guard it until the spell ends. Creatures that have Immunity to the Charmed condition automatically succeed on their saving throws against this spell.

name: Disrupt the Wyrd
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take in response to a saving throw being rolled by a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself)
components: V, S, M (a tangle of thread)
descriptionHtml: The creature rerolls the saving throw, either adding your spellcasting modifier to or subtracting it from the new roll. It must use the new result.

name: Drummer's Cadence
descriptionHtml: For the duration, you radiate an aura in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]. Whenever an allied ship in this area moves by oar, its Speed increases by 10 ft. The vessel must be sufficiently crewed for this spell to have any effect.

name: Earthsail
components: V, S, M (a handful of mud and a handful of sea water)
descriptionHtml:
You touch a sailing vessel with a crew of up to 10 throughout the spell's casting, imbuing it with the ability to treat earth as though it were sea. For the duration, the vessel treats soil, mud, and packed dirt as though it were water, pushing through it and leaving a rippling wake of re-solidified terrain. Snow, ice, plants (including trees), and small stones are temporarily swept aside in the ship's wake, but boulders and mountains must be sailed around.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 7th-level spell slot, it can affect a vessel with a crew of up to 30, and it lasts for 24 hours. If you cast this spell with a 9th-level spell slot, it can affect a vessel with a crew of any size, and it lasts for 1 week.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 7th-level spell slot, it can affect a vessel with a crew of up to 30, and it lasts for 24 hours. If you cast this spell with a 9th-level spell slot, it can affect a vessel with a crew of any size, and it lasts for 1 week.

name: Encase in Ice
components: V, S, M (a handful of water)
descriptionHtml:
A crashing wave of water fills a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. The water instantly freezes in place. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature's legs are trapped in the ice, and the creature has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A creature with the Restrained condition can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success. Another creature can take the Help action to attempt to free the trapped creature, making the same check.

Creatures that were not in the spell's area when you cast it treat the area as Difficult Terrain. If a creature that is not Restrained by the ice enters the area or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 3rd-level spell slot, the ice entraps the target's arms as well as its legs. The target cannot take the Attack action or cast spells with somatic components until the Restrained condition ends.

If you cast this spell using a 5th-level spell slot, the ice completely entombs creatures in the area when you cast the spell. Creatures that fail their initial save are Restrained and have Cover for the spell's duration. An affected creature can make a Strength save at the end of each of its turns to break out, but whether it succeeds or fails, it takes 2d6 Cold damage as its flesh, which was stuck to the ice, tears.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 3rd-level spell slot, the ice entraps the target's arms as well as its legs. The target cannot take the Attack action or cast spells with somatic components until the Restrained condition ends.

If you cast this spell using a 5th-level spell slot, the ice completely entombs creatures in the area when you cast the spell. Creatures that fail their initial save are Restrained and have Cover for the spell's duration. An affected creature can make a Strength save at the end of each of its turns to break out, but whether it succeeds or fails, it takes 2d6 Cold damage as its flesh, which was stuck to the ice, tears.

name: Ensnared Threads
components: V, S, M (a knotted string of wool)
descriptionHtml:
The Norns allow you to briefly force a connection between the threads of your fate and those of another creature. A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you form a connection between yourself and the target.

Once per turn, until the spell ends, the first attack that hits you hits the target creature instead, if it can be targeted by the attack. If that creature cannot be the target of the attack, the attack hits you normally.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with an 8th- or 9th- level spell slot, all attacks that hit you instead hit the target. Any of the attacks the creature cannot be the target of still hit you normally.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with an 8th- or 9th- level spell slot, all attacks that hit you instead hit the target. Any of the attacks the creature cannot be the target of still hit you normally.

name: Extinguish
descriptionHtml:
You extinguish all magical and nonmagical flames of your choice in a 60-foot Cube [Area of Effect] originating from you. Creatures made partially or completely of fire take 1d12 Force damage.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

For each spell slot above 1st that you use to cast this spell, the cube increases by 10 feet and affected creatures take an additional 1d12 Force damage.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

For each spell slot above 1st that you use to cast this spell, the cube increases by 10 feet and affected creatures take an additional 1d12 Force damage.

name: Eyes of the Raven
descriptionHtml:
You call upon the power of Wotan's all-knowing ravens, Huginn and Muninn. While the spell lasts, you have Advantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saves.

As a Magic action, you can gain Truesight with a range of 30 feet. This lasts until the start of your next turn. Then the spell ends.

name: Fenris's Howl
descriptionHtml: You channel the piercing, death-dirge howl of the Fenris wolf at a point that you can see within range and gain strength from others' fear. Creatures that you choose within 60 feet of that point that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition (with you as the source) for the duration of the spell. While at least one creature affected by the spell remains Frightened, your Speed is doubled, and you deal an extra 3d6 Necrotic damage to a Frightened enemy with each of your attacks.

name: Fiery Siege
components: V, S, M (a bit of pitch)
descriptionHtml: You touch a siege weapon, imbuing it with pyroclastic power. For the duration, the siege weapon deals an extra 1d10 Fire damage when it hits. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a different siege engine, transferring the effect to it.

name: Fire Rune
descriptionHtml: You touch a melee weapon and place a magical effect into it, creating a visible rune etched into the weapon. Attacks made by the invoked weapon deal an extra 1d8 Fire damage on a hit.

name: Fist of the Frost Jarl
components: V, S, M (a drop of water melted from an icicle)
descriptionHtml:
A fist of solid ice filling a 5-foot Cube [Area of Effect] hurtles from you in a direction you choose in a 120-foot Line [Area of Effect]. Each creature in the Line [Area of Effect] makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Cold damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage.

You may choose for one creature of Huge size or smaller that fails its save to have the Grappled condition, which has an escape DC equal to your spell save DC. A creature that ends its turn Grappled by the fist takes 2d8 Cold damage. When a creature escapes the grapple, the fist shatters.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4th. If cast using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the spell ignores Resistance to Cold damage.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4th. If cast using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the spell ignores Resistance to Cold damage.

name: Freezing Fog
descriptionHtml:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] of bone-chilling fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere [Area of Effect] is Heavily Obscured and considered Difficult Terrain. The fog lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.

Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere [Area of Effect], or moves into its area, must succeed on a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d4 Cold damage for every 5 feet it travels.

You have Immunity to all of the effects of this spell.

name: Freyja's Allure
descriptionHtml:
One creature of your choice that you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and can't willingly move farther away from you for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, the creature can make another Charisma saving throw. The target has Disadvantage on the save if it can see you and you are within 30 feet of it. On a successful save, the spell ends on it.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1st.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1st.

name: Freyja's Grace
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take after failing a saving throw.)
descriptionHtml: Reroll the saving throw as a Charisma save, regardless of the original save type.

name: Ghostly Crew
descriptionHtml: You summon intangible spirits to crew a touched vessel. For the duration of the spell, as long as you are within 30 feet of the vessel, it is considered to have a sufficient number of sailors to take a full complement of normal ship actions (including movement and using siege weapons). The spirits can't take other actions or engage in any other activities, such as fighting independently or repairing the vessel.

name: Giant's Teeth
components: V, S, M (a handful of molars)
descriptionHtml:
Two half-circles of enormous teeth erupt from the ground and slam together to crush a creature of your choice within 90 feet.

The target has the Grappled condition. The escape DC is equal to your spell save DC. At the beginning of each of its turns while it has the Grappled condition, the creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage. If the target escapes, the spell ends.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

When you cast this spell using a 5th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d10. When you cast it using a 7th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 5d8. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases to 6d8.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

When you cast this spell using a 5th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d10. When you cast it using a 7th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 5d8. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases to 6d8.

name: Giantbane
descriptionHtml: You have Advantage on attack rolls against Large or larger creatures, and your attacks deal an extra 2d6 Force damage against such creatures.

name: Giantdodge
descriptionHtml: Increase your Speed by 20 feet. You gain a +2 Bonus to your AC against attacks made by Large or larger creatures, and you do not provoke Opportunity Attack from them.

name: Glimpse the Wyrd
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when a creature succeeds or fails on a D20 Test)
descriptionHtml: You add or subtract 1d6 from the D20 Test.

name: Hearthfire
descriptionHtml: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. Within the spell's area of Bright Light, you and each creature you choose have Immunity to the harmful effects of Extreme Cold.

name: Hungry Jaws of Fenris
descriptionHtml:
As a Magic action, you channel the power of Fenris, the Great Wolf, transforming your mouth into a gaping maw. This doesn't impede your movement or actions, but you can't speak or cast spells with verbal components for the duration.

While the spell is active, you can use your jaws to make a bite attack. On a hit, the target takes Piercing damage equal to 4d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and it has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC).

If you bite a target already Grappled by you, you can choose to swallow it, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature is shunted into a pocket dimension. While there, it has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the dimension, and takes 3d12 Force damage at the start of each of your turns. You can't swallow a creature if you have already swallowed a creature using this spell.

A swallowed creature can make a save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, you vomit the creature to the nearest unoccupied space of your choice. The same thing occurs if the spell's duration elapses.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage dealt by the bite attack increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 6th.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage dealt by the bite attack increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 6th.

name: Ice Shape
descriptionHtml: You touch a section of ice no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like. For example, you could shape the ice into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or you could make a small passage through the ice that is 5 feet thick. You could also shape ice to seal a narrow cavern opening shut. Any object you create is crude but functional, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.

name: Icewalker
components: V, S, M (a shard of ice)
descriptionHtml:
For the duration, you radiate an aura in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]. While in the aura, you and creatures of your choice gain the following benefits:

  • Treat slippery ice as normal terrain
  • Treat your weight as one-tenth normal for the purpose of breaking through thin ice

name: Inbar's Giant-Friend
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when a Giant sees you)
components: V, S, M (a hair or nail clipping from a goblinoid)
descriptionHtml: Your eyes flash with golden light. The Giant must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, its attitude toward you improves 1 step, such as from Hostile [Attitude] to Indifferent [Attitude] or Indifferent [Attitude] to Friendly [Attitude]. A creature's attitude is dynamic, so how you behave toward the giant from this point on can further affect its attitude. A Giant with Immunity to the Charmed condition has Immunity to this spell. Once you have cast this spell on any given Giant, you cannot cast it again on that Giant.

name: Infectious Skal
descriptionHtml:
You sing a boisterous drinking song that compels others to stop what they are doing and sing along. A creature that can hear you within the spell's range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the spell ends. While the creature is Charmed, it is Friendly [Attitude] toward you, and it takes no actions other than to sing along with the song. For the duration of the song, you may use a Bonus Action to target a new creature that is within 30 feet of you or of another creature singing the song. You can affect a total number of creatures equal to your Spellcasting ability modifier at any one time, adding them progressively. A targeted creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Charmed by you and begin singing along. If any of the singers other than you is attacked during the song, the song stops with a loud discordant note, and the spell ends for everyone affected.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 3rd or higher-level spell slot, you can affect 2 creatures each time you take a Bonus Action to spread the song.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 3rd or higher-level spell slot, you can affect 2 creatures each time you take a Bonus Action to spread the song.

name: Jotun Form
components: V, S, M (a shard of a giant animal's bone)
descriptionHtml:
You shape-shift into a Giant for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature of the Giant type that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen that sort of creature before.

When you cast the spell, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which you shape-shift. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.

Upon shapeshifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.

name: Loki's Escape
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take after taking damage)
descriptionHtml: You have the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn. While the spell lasts, you may use your Bonus Action to move your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack. The spell ends early immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

name: Luckfingers
descriptionHtml:
You touch one Medium or smaller creature, suffusing it with confidence and skill. Until the spell ends, the creature has Advantage on all ability checks. If such a check results in failure, the creature can choose to end the spell and automatically succeed on the ability check.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3rd. If a creature chooses to end the spell to automatically succeed on an ability check, the spell ends only for them.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3rd. If a creature chooses to end the spell to automatically succeed on an ability check, the spell ends only for them.

name: Melody of Sheltered Rest
descriptionHtml: You sing or hum an upbeat melody. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]. A creature within the aura (including you) can extend the duration for another 2 hours, as long as it continues singing. This can repeat for as long as a creature within the aura continues singing. While in the aura, creatures have Advantage on Perception checks and cannot be Surprised.

name: Murmurs of Doom
descriptionHtml: You begin a whispered dirge that is magically accompanied by the howling of spirits and other grim portents. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it persists, you can choose one creature in it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 3d8 Necrotic damage.

name: Noble Sacrifice
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when a creature you can see drops to 0 Hit Points or fails its third Death Saving Throw)
descriptionHtml: The creature is restored to 1 Hit Point, and you lose half of your current Hit Points.

name: Ode to Wrath
descriptionHtml: You begin a poetic chant that is magically accompanied by a trio of pounding drums beating an angry rhythm. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]. While in the aura, you and your allies each add your spellcasting ability modifier to damage rolls made with melee weapons.

name: Pawn of the Wyrd
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when another creature takes a Reaction)
descriptionHtml: You cast your fate to the winds and accept the guidance of The Norns. The creature does not take that Reaction and cannot take a different Reaction. If the Reaction would have expended a spell slot or other ability, nothing is expended. You lose your next Reaction.

name: Protection Rune
descriptionHtml: You touch a creature, creating a visible rune etched into its skin. The creature has Resistance to a damage type of your choice.

name: Reaver's Rune
descriptionHtml: You touch a melee weapon and place a magical effect into it, creating a visible rune etched into the weapon. No more than once per turn, a creature wielding the weapon can make an attack roll with the weapon with Advantage when it would not otherwise have Advantage. If the weapon leaves the creature's possession, the spell ends.

name: Regenerative Hull
descriptionHtml: You touch a vehicle. At the start of each of your turns, the vehicle regains a number of Hit Points equal to twice your spellcasting modifier. A vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.

name: Reinforce Hull
descriptionHtml: A vehicle you touch has its damage threshold increased by your spellcasting ability modifier for the duration. A vehicle with no damage threshold can't be targeted by this spell.

name: Repair Hull
descriptionHtml:
A vehicle you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The target vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d12 for each spell level above 3rd.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d12 for each spell level above 3rd.

name: Sailor's Shanty
descriptionHtml: You touch a vehicle. The crew of the vehicle has Advantage on D20 Test to control or operate the vehicle.

name: Shared Expertise
components: V, S, M (a piece of boot leather)
descriptionHtml:
For the duration, you radiate an aura in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]. Choose up to 2 skills that you have Expertise in. If you have no Expertise in a skill, this spell has no effect.

While in the area, allied creatures are treated as having Proficiency in the chosen skills. If an ally already has Proficiency or Expertise in the skill, they gain no benefit.

name: Shield-Maiden's Favor
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when you or an ally takes damage)
descriptionHtml:
A spiritual echo of a Valhallan shield-maiden appears and interposes herself between the triggering attack and its target, then the shieldmaiden vanishes. The triggering attack's damage is reduced by 1d10 plus your spellcasting modifier.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage reduction increases by 1d10 for each spell level above 1st.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage reduction increases by 1d10 for each spell level above 1st.

name: Sif's Grace
components: V, M (two silver beads of equal weight)
descriptionHtml:
You grant a measure of Sif's speed and sure-footedness to a creature within reach. Until the spell ends, the target's Speed doubles, and creatures that make Opportunity Attack against the target have Disadvantage on their attack rolls. If the target moves on its turn, it has Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

If the target is subject to an effect that requires it to make a Dexterity save, it can choose to automatically succeed. That ends this spell for it.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3rd.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Skaldic Scolding
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself)
descriptionHtml:
The creature that damaged you is bombarded with a barrage of scathing insults and must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has the Incapacitated condition until the start of your next turn. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, it has the Stunned condition instead. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell level above 4th.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell level above 4th.

name: Song of the Shield Wall
descriptionHtml:
You begin a chant that is magically accompanied by the clanging sound of hammers against iron. Glowing, spectral, circular shields appear before a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier who are within 30 feet of you. Each creature gains a +2 bonus to their AC.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 6th level spell slot, the bonus to AC increased to +3, and if you use an 8th level spell slot, it increases to +4.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

If you cast this spell with a 6th level spell slot, the bonus to AC increased to +3, and if you use an 8th level spell slot, it increases to +4.

name: Speechmaster's Rune
descriptionHtml: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. Any creature holding the stone has Advantage on Charisma checks.

name: Storm Maiden's Edge
descriptionHtml:
You touch a weapon and imbue it with the power of the storm. Until the spell ends, the chosen weapon deals an extra 2d8 Lightning damage on a hit.

A creature hit by the weapon must make a Strength saving throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed save, the target is pushed back 10 feet. If the target fails the Strength save by 5 or more, it has the Prone condition.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The amount of extra Lightning damage dealt by the weapon increases by 1d8 for every two spell slot levels above 3rd.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The amount of extra Lightning damage dealt by the weapon increases by 1d8 for every two spell slot levels above 3rd.

name: Summon Leviathan Avatar
components: V, S, M (a drop of seawater)
descriptionHtml:
You call forth the spirit of the mythical leviathan. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Leviathan Avatar stat block. The space you choose must be filled with enough water to contain the size of the leviathan, otherwise the spell ends immediately. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The leviathan is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Sun Rune
descriptionHtml:
You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. You can only have one Sun Rune spell active at a time.

Once while the spell lasts, any creature holding the stone may use an Action to invoke the rune's power and throw it at a target up to 60 feet away. It stops early if it impacts against a solid surface. When the stone lands or impacts, the rune triggers.

When the rune triggers, the blazing heat of the sun flashes in a 30-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on the stone. Each creature in the Sphere [Area of Effect] makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d6 Fire damage and 4d6 Radiant damage, or half as much on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Sphere [Area of Effect] that aren't being worn or carried start burning. Ice or snow within the Sphere [Area of Effect] vaporizes into a fog that fills the Sphere [Area of Effect], making it Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong wind (such as one created by the Gust of Wind spell) disperses it.

After activating the rune's power, the creature cannot activate another Sun Rune again until after a Long Rest.

name: Talons of the Eagle
descriptionHtml:
You imbue yourself with the power of the eagle. While the spell lasts, you have Advantage on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saves.

As a Magic action, you can briefly transform your hands into a set of talons, then move up to your Speed and make a melee talon attack. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d8 for every two spell slot levels above 1st.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d8 for every two spell slot levels above 1st.

name: Thought Rune
descriptionHtml: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. A creature holding the stone has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.

name: Trickster's Bluff
components: V, M (the petrified tongue of a serpent)
descriptionHtml: You are graced with a measure of Loki's silver tongue. You have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. If you fail such a check, you can choose to deal 1d4 Psychic damage to the creature you failed to deceive, and that creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Trollblood Infusion
components: V, S, M (a drop of troll blood)
descriptionHtml: A creature you touch is magically infused with the regenerative properties of troll blood. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns, if it has at least 1 Hit Point, and automatically succeeds on Death Saving Throw. If the creature takes Acid or Fire damage, this effect does not function at the start of its next turn.

name: Truth's Blade
components: V, S, M (A silver pin, which is not consumed)
descriptionHtml:
You punish one who would speak falsely to you. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, for the duration, it takes 4d8 Psychic damage whenever it lies.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The amount of Psychic damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3rd.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The amount of Psychic damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Valhalla's Cohort
descriptionHtml:
You conjure warrior spirits from Valhalla, the hall of the honored dead. The spirits appear as a Huge cohort of spectral, intangible warriors in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirits brandish spears, axes, and blades, striking at anyone nearby. The cohort lasts for the duration, and you choose the spirits' appearance (such as their species and any insignias worn).

You can also move the cohort 30 feet as a Bonus Action on your subsequent turns.

If the cohort ends its move within 5 feet of a creature, or if a creature moves within 5 feet of the cohort, you can make a melee spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 2d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. A creature can be attacked in this way only once per turn.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4th.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4th.

name: Valkyrie's Guidance
components: V, S, M (a polished blue stone)
descriptionHtml: You consult the Valkyries and ask them to guide your hand to glory in Valhalla. Choose a creature you can see. For the duration of the spell, you gain Advantage on melee attack rolls against that creature and Intelligence checks to recall lore about it. The spell ends immediately if you don't attack the creature on your turn.

name: Valkyrie's Vision
descriptionHtml:
You see how near to death other creatures are. Until the spell ends, you know the current Hit Point total of each creature you can see within 30 feet of you, and you can see how many levels of Exhaustion it has.

As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can cause a creature within 30 feet of you that is dying to become Stable. Doing so ends the spell immediately.

name: Wall of Snow
components: V, S, M (a freshly packed snowball)
descriptionHtml:
You create a wall of packed snow on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick. Or you can make a 10-foot-radius, hemispherical dome. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration.

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 10 and 10 Hit Points per 10-foot section, and it has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage, and Vulnerability to Fire and Radiant damage. Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 Hit Points destroys it.

Creatures within an undamaged dome have Immunity to the effects of Extreme Cold while the spell lasts.

If you cast this spell in an area of snowy terrain, it blends seamlessly with the existing snow. If a creature takes a Study action to examine the wall, the creature can differentiate the wall from the surrounding terrain with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

name: Weave Detonation
components: V, S, M (a short piece of thread)
descriptionHtml:
An invisible, soundless burst of fate erupts at a point you choose. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on that point makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has Disadvantage on all D20 Test for 1 minute.

A creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.


Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

For each spell slot level above 3rd, you can exclude up to five creatures within the radius from the spell's effects.
higherLevelHtml:
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.

For each spell slot level above 3rd, you can exclude up to five creatures within the radius from the spell's effects.

name: Whiteout
descriptionHtml:
You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.

When you cast this spell, you create a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] of heavy fog and flurrying snow centered on you. The Sphere [Area of Effect] is Heavily Obscured and the terrain within it is Difficult Terrain. Any creature that begins its turn in the Sphere [Area of Effect] or enters the Sphere [Area of Effect] on its turn must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or receive 1 Exhaustion level. Creatures that have Resistance or Immunity to Cold damage automatically succeed on this save.

When you cast the spell, you may designate a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. These creatures do not receive levels of Exhaustion from the spell.

When the spell ends, all snow created by it disappears instantly and the Exhaustion levels end.

name: Wotan's Retribution
castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when a creature scores a Critical Hit against you)
descriptionHtml: You teleport directly behind the creature that triggered this Reaction and make a melee attack against it with a weapon you are wielding. You have Advantage on your attack roll. On a hit, the creature takes the damage from your attack as well as an amount of damage equal to the damage it dealt to you when it triggered this Reaction.

name: Wyrd Sight
descriptionHtml: You manipulate the threads of luck and fate to work in your favor. No more than once per turn, you can roll 1d12 and add or subtract it from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.
